description:
Martian Atlas is an interactive, layered web application built to help future explorers and rovers plan safe Martian treks across Jezero Crater while conducting science along the way.

 Our solution unifies multi-mission NASA and USGS open data into a single survival map, combining HiRISE orbital imagery, MOLA/HRSC elevation models, 21 real Perseverance science sample sites, and 325 cataloged surface hazards rated 1–5 in criticality. Using an A* pathfinding engine over a 50 m terrain-cost grid.
